name: classic-geode-green
_comment: GEODE_GREEN_CONFIRM healthy path -- the regression guard that arming green confirm does not disturb a working geode cycle. Same world as classic-geode (1-dig fill, Pan cue, momentum shake) except the dig-bar green pixel IS painted over the GEODE_DIG_MS tap, so the very first tap proves itself on green: exactly ONE tap, no re-taps, State.geode_green_ok latches True off the positive proof with no calibration probe needed, and the leg then behaves identically to classic-geode (animation wait bails on FULL, judge counts the dig, go_water, geode shake). The green rect covers the whole SAMPLE_BOX around DIG_TRIGGER_PIXEL so the averaged read passes is_green(). Lives in engine_goldens/classic_trace (NOT engine_scenarios/); vendored to the Studio.
_screen_comment: Whole-box capacity paint (see classic-shards): keyframes are 0/1 only. The second rect is the dig skill-bar's GREEN zone painted over the SAMPLE_BOX around DIG_TRIGGER_PIXEL (1078, 532) for the length of the dig animation, from just after the tap releases at 85.
